name: Otherworldly Prowl
text:
Frequency once per day

Requirements You're being Concealed by, or gaining cover from, a natural source such as foliage or mist.

---
You sink deeper into the shadows, drawing fey magic around yourself to stalk your prey unseen. You become Invisible until you leave the source of your concealment or cover. If your hunting partner is in your wild link aura and meets the requirements, they also become invisible until either of you leaves the source of your concealment or cover.
